nom: Paula's Choice Resist Weightless Advanced Repairing Toner

avis.texte: This is my 4th purchase. I have oily, hormonal, acne prone skin and this toner is an essential part of my skin care routine. I use Paula's Choice BHA & Vitamin C as well & won't go without.

Paula’s Choice Resist Weightless Advanced Repairing Toner is everything it claims—super lightweight, calming, and perfect for my skin. It absorbs instantly, no stickiness, just pure hydration and balance. My skin feels smoother, looks brighter, and stays happy. Quietly powerful and totally essential—this toner is a keeper!
I did give it five stars because it’s not bad. However it’s just another toner and seems to do “nothing”, so not life altering. Very pricey imo.

avis.titre: Use every day for at least a month
avis.texte: Been using it for about a month and my skin feels noticeably smoother! I love it. It is a little bit pricier than I usually spend but it’s worth it since it dors the job

I think it did what it was supposed to do, but I didn’t notice any amazing changes in my skin or anything. What I didn’t like is that it goes fast, and I had to re-order often. For this reason, I changed to something else that was a little cheaper and would last longer.

avis.texte: I absolutely adore my Paula’s Choice products. My daughter (18) & I (54) both use the acne product line, (though I have a few extra products for anti-aging that she doesn’t need). Both of us have noticed a major glow-up after a month of regular use!
This truly is the best stuff ever. I really saw a difference in my skin even after a few days of using it. It is a little expensive for a toner, but I definitely recommend.

J’utilise ce produit depuis maintenant depuis 1 mois, c’est un très bon produit. J’ai vu une légère amélioration sur mon teint et point noir et sur certaines rides mais encore fois c’est léger car cela fait 1 mois que je l’utilise.

Dieses Produkt ist zwar teuerer als das reguläre Gesichtswasser aus der Drogerie, kommt dafür aber mit mehreren aktiven Inhaltsstoffen und guter Verträglichkeit daher. Ich habe Mischhaut mit einigen eher trockenen Stellen. Das Gesichtswasser trocknet meine Haut nicht zusätzliche aus und fühlt sich beim auftragen angenehm frisch an. Ich verwende es morgens und abends nach der Gesichtsreinigung.

avis.titre: Un tónico eficaz y suave para una piel equilibradaUn tónico eficaz y suave para una piel equilibrada
avis.texte: El tónico RESIST de Paula’s Choice ha sido una gran adición a mi rutina de cuidado de la piel. Es suave pero efectivo, dejando mi piel fresca y equilibrada sin resecarla. He notado una mejor textura y una reducción en la apariencia de los poros después de usarlo regularmente. Además, se siente muy ligero en la piel y no provoca irritación, incluso en mi piel sensible. Es perfecto para preparar el rostro antes de los siguientes pasos de la rutina. ¡Definitivamente un producto que recomendaría para mantener la piel saludable y radiante!
